risk_statement: Because final tool-design approval may slip beyond the release date, tool manufacture and trial production may start late, delaying PPAP and Start of Production.
mitigation: Hold weekly design closure review and confirm alternate tool-room capacity.

risk_statement: Because the production trial may not generate sufficient capability evidence, the PPAP submission may be delayed, affecting customer launch approval.
mitigation: Complete trial plan, MSA readiness and capability-data collection before the customer submission window.

risk_statement: Because the approved polymer grade may not be available at the required volume, pilot production may stop and validation samples may be delayed.
mitigation: Confirm supplier allocation and qualify an approved secondary source subject to customer requirements.
